mutations.name: the abandon close deletes the PR's branch
kills: abandon on a dead-end gate abandon runs `agent-chat gh-write -- pr close <n> --repo <r>` with no --delete-branch, leaves the branch ref, reopens the task with a note, and stops the run as abandoned

mutations.name: abandon closes a PR whose head moved past the gate head
kills: abandon on a dead-end gate abandon at a head the PR moved past closes nothing and re-asks

mutations.name: a replayed abandon does not read that the PR is already closed
kills: abandon on a dead-end gate a replayed sh-abandon does not close twice

mutations.name: abandon closes a PR on an advisory repo
kills: abandon on a dead-end gate abandon on an advisory repo runs no command, leaves the PR open and the task as it is, and only stops the run
